crossRefs.note: “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, to Mount Nebo, which is in the land of Moab, that is across from Jericho; and see…
Moses went up from the plains of Moab to Mount Nebo, to the top of Pisgah, that is opposite Jericho. Yahweh showed him…
Yahweh said to Moses, “Go up into this mountain of Abarim, and see the land which I have given to the children of…
These all died in faith, not having received the promises, but having seen them and embraced them from afar, and having…
These all, having had testimony given to them through their faith, didn’t receive the promise,

people.name: Israel
people.line: Patriarch, son of Isaac, father of twelve tribes

translations.web: For you shall see the land from a distance; but you shall not go there into the land which I give the children of Israel.”
translations.bsb: Although you shall see from a distance the land that I am giving the Israelites, you shall not enter it.”
translations.kjv: Yet thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither unto the land which I give the children of Israel.
translations.asv: For thou shalt see the land before thee; but thou shalt not go thither into the land which I give the children of Israel.
